subject: Trading
title: Forward Guidance
description: A quick, practical guide to Forward Guidance.

hook.text: Central bankers move markets with words alone. A single phrase can shift billions in currency positions.

buildup.text: Forward guidance is when central banks signal their future intentions—hinting at rate changes before they happen.

discovery.text: Markets price in expectations instantly. By the time a rate hike happens, its effect is already in the price.

twist.text: The surprise isn't the action—it's the deviation from guidance. A bank that promised patience then hikes shocks markets.

climax.text: In forex, trading the expectation matters more than trading the event. Guidance is the real signal.

punchline.text: Markets trade what's next, not what just happened.

quiz.question: Why does forward guidance move markets before actual rate changes?
options: Markets price in expectations immediately upon receiving guidance
